teaser: A rental car, cruise control holding steady, you still keep flicking between lanes — that's a version of life path 9, ENTP. Nine asks for a letting go that serves something larger than one person; ENTP takes an idea apart to see what's underneath it, then takes apart the next one. Crossed, the two make a person who can love a cause faster than a person standing in front of them, who changes course on principle rather than mere restlessness, and who sometimes forgets which exit the whole drive was for.
